open_questions: API Group II confirmed from Petro-Canada's official Group II typical-properties table; the original DL2-10020.pdf did not explicitly assign a grade-specific group.
Viscosity index remains unreported for PURITY L50.

Grade-specific CCS remains Missing: the CCS values previously recorded here at -20°C and -25°C belong to PURITY 2204, not L50; no CCS value for PURITY L50 has been found in Petro-Canada documentation (see the 'CCS (2026-10 audit)' note).
Grade-specific SDS and differences between the original 2015 brochure and newer manufacturer documentation require reconciliation.

CCS (2026-10 audit): the 2 CCS values previously recorded here - 2708 mPa.s at -20 °C, 5361 mPa.s at -25 °C (Reported, Typical, ASTM D5293; cited to https://petrocanadalubricants.com/en-us/brand/purity-base-oils/compare, no page) - are the PURITY 2204 column of Petro-Canada's 'Typical Properties of PURITY Base Oils' table in LUB3213E / IM-1809E (2023.03) p.2, not PURITY L50. The 2015.07 edition (DL2-10020.pdf p.2) prints 3400 cP at -20 °C and 7000 cP at -25 °C for PURITY 2204 and no CCS for L50; the PURITY L50 product data sheet DL2-13351.pdf (last reviewed May 2020) prints no CCS; the cited compare page could not be retrieved (bot protection). The L35-L65 table in both editions has no Cold Crank Simulator row, so no CCS value is published for PURITY L50; ccs is now Missing. The values were not copied to any other record. Confirm with Petro-Canada whether a CCS value exists for PURITY L50.
